questions.text: How many columns does this dataset have in total (including the label column)?
How many feature columns are there, excluding the class/label column?
What is the name of the label/target column?
Are the feature columns (f1...f617) numeric or categorical?
Which class has the fewest samples, and how many?
Is the dataset perfectly class-balanced (same number of rows per class)?
What is the standard deviation of column f1?
What is the mean value of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f100?
What are the min and max values of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f617?
How many rows have a value of f1 greater than 0?
What is the Pearson correlation coefficient between f1 and f2?
What is the average value of f300 for rows in class 20?
How many samples belong to class 6?

notes.problem: Questions failed with 'column does not exist', and class filters matched zero rows.
notes.root_cause: The schema summary was built but never appended to the prompt; the class column held literal quote characters and the sandbox loaded the CSV without cleaning.
notes.fix: Append the summary lines; one shared quote-stripping utility for extractor and sandbox; golden code updated for numeric class; number extraction anchored on linking words.
notes.result: Final 15-question pass. Still open: count_05 is a two-part question scored as one value; count_06 has tied classes.

config.data_cleaning: shared strip_stray_quotes() utility (core/utils/data_cleaning.py), used by both CSVExtractor._load() and PandasSandboxTool's worker process -- strips embedded quote characters from object-dtype columns and converts to numeric where every value parses cleanly
config.schema_serialization: to_prompt_string() with THRESHOLD=20 truncation; columns past the cutoff are now summarized by name and dtype (previously computed but never appended -- fixed)
config.tool_registration: generator.tools set explicitly in eval script to match production's per-request mutation
config.pandas_sandbox_description: explicitly instructs the model to check df.columns / inspect values for columns not shown in full schema detail
config.synthesis_call: fresh system+user messages, no tools/tool_choice passed, explicit no-tool/no-function-call instruction; wrapped in try/except with raw-tool-result fallback on synthesis failure
config.call_1_retry: 3 attempts with 1s delay on failure, graceful error message after exhausting retries
config.scoring: deterministic numeric/range/string match (via compute_golden_value using golden_pandas_code) with LLM-judge fallback for categorical/fuzzy answers; extract_number/extract_all_numbers anchor on linking words (is/are/equals/approximately) rather than first-or-last-number position, with letter-prefix-rejection as fallback for answers without linking verbs
config.tolerance: 0.001 globally (raised from 0.0001 across all golden_dataset.json questions)
config.tracer: generate_with_tools()'s tracer hook wired from the eval script, capturing per-question pandas_code and raw_tool_result alongside the final answer
